title.en: Does the draft decide the game?

home_desc.en: An interactive essay on 222,652 ranked LoL matches: the draft predicts winners only modestly, the first 10–20 minutes far better. Exploratory results.

desc.en: An interactive essay from 222,652 ranked LoL matches: the draft alone predicts the winner only modestly (AUC about 0.57), the first 10–20 minutes far better. Results are exploratory.
desc.zh: 基于 222,652 场英雄联盟排位赛的交互式长文：仅凭选人预测胜负的效果有限（AUC 约 0.57），前 10–20 分钟的局势准得多。结果属探索性分析。

desc.zh: 一个 Agentic 投资研究类项目。

desc.en: Draw a card each day, do the small real-world thing it asks, and log it. Over time a garden and a card collection fill up.
desc.zh: 每天抽一张卡，去现实里做一件小事，回来记下。日子久了，花园和卡册会慢慢长满。

desc.en: A phone app for singing in tune: measure your range, sing to target notes, and see live whether you are sharp or flat.
desc.zh: 练音准的手机应用：测音域，跟着目标音唱，实时看自己偏高还是偏低。

desc.en: Import a route, read it segment by segment (distance, climb, resupply), plan the trip, and log it afterwards.
desc.zh: 导入路线，按分段看距离、爬升和补给，排好行程，走完再记一笔。

desc.en: Ask the same questions of a stack of papers. A model answers each with quoted evidence; you check the answers and export a workbook.
desc.zh: 给一批论文提同一组问题，模型逐篇作答并附原文证据，人工核对后导出成表。

desc.en: Export your own WeChat chats on your own computer, together with their voice messages, images and files; the text is searchable, and every message keeps its time and where it came from.
desc.zh: 在自己的电脑上，把自己的微信聊天记录连同语音、图片和文件一起导出；文字可以搜索，每条消息都保留时间和出处。

desc.en: A phone app for keeping pet birds: a profile for each bird, one diary for weight, food and mood, and care notes for common species.
desc.zh: 养鸟的手机应用：每只鸟一份档案，体重、饮食、状态记在同一本日记里，还能查常见鸟种的照护要点。

desc.en: For everyday neck, back and joint strain: check first for signs that mean see a doctor, log how it changes day by day, and bring a summary to the appointment.
desc.zh: 记日常的颈肩腰膝不适：先对照哪些情况该去就医，再一天天记下变化，看医生时带上一份整理好的摘要。

desc.en: Import a batch of photos; it reads their shooting details and colours, sorts them into album ideas, and helps you pick the frames and put them in order.
desc.zh: 导入一批照片，读出拍摄信息和色调，归成几组相册候选，再帮你挑片、排顺序。

desc.en: A wuxia RPG prototype: walk the inn and the roads around it, question people, pin clues to a board, and confront the suspect.
desc.zh: 武侠 RPG 原型：在醉仙楼一带走动、问话、收集线索，把线索摆上线索板，当面对质。

desc.en: A murder mystery for one player: pick a script and a seat, and an AI host and AI players take you through the search, the discussion, the vote and the reveal.
desc.zh: 一个人也能玩的剧本杀：选好剧本和角色，AI 主持人和其他角色陪你搜证、讨论、投票、复盘。

desc.en: An OpenClaw agent's first six days, in its own voice: birth, switching models, and the files that hold an identity together.
desc.zh: 一个 OpenClaw agent 用自己的声音讲述最初六天：诞生、切换模型，以及用文件维系身份。

desc.en: Climbing Haba Snow Mountain, 5,396 m: training, risk, and what the body reports back.

note.en: Worked out note by note from this recording in October 2026: the melody with its lyrics, the chords, and the harmony part. Still being checked by ear. The numbered notation is in 1 = F, written an octave above the sung pitch, as is usual for a male voice.
